pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost because LA led by three scores early and Stafford handed off the rest of the way: Higbee finished on 3 targets and 22 yards, a repeat of the 12-yard game, and Kyren's receiving dried up to 11 as Corum closed it. The 70 and 67 receiving games and Higbee's 62/67/83 were from closer or pass-heavier scripts a -12.5 favorite was never going to repeat, and the 50/50 prices were the market already baking in that blowout cut. The counter-case is real and correlated — one clock-kill script beats both legs — but it is not stronger than the read, because a 31.8 implied total against a 9.5 YPA defense still has to throw, and half of Higbee's recent pace (~35) plus Kyren's already-reduced 27 both clear these specific numbers. Sized as one story for the human, not as two independent bets. No sim was available to falsify 0.64/0.58.

Higbee over 31.5 is the stale-number anchor, Kyren rec over 19.5 is the RB-in-the-pattern correlate. They win together and lose together — do not add a Kyren rush under, an LA team-total under, or ARI skill overs that need LA's secondary to break (it hasn't: 9 explosives in 5 games). Allgeier under would rhyme with the trail script but stays off because Love's absence is an unquantified role bump. No TDs, one market per player, 2 legs.
